data_description.token: Create an API key at energiedaten.at → Settings → API Keys (scopes: meters:read, data:read). Keys expire — Community plan caps at 365 days; re-authenticate before then.

data_description.community_share: Adds a Community share sensor per meter: energy drawn from your energy community (consumption) or fed into it (feed-in). Turning this on re-imports your history once. Meters outside an energy community read 0.

reimport.name: Re-import data
reimport.description: Reset sync progress and re-fetch all historical meter data from energiedaten.at. Existing statistics are overwritten, not duplicated.
